name: Dmitry Fursov
title: Unity Developer
employment: Open to full-time, part-time and contract work
summary: Unity generalist working across gameplay, VR/AR, networking and UI. Building interactive products since 2019, with commercial experience in Unity/C# and frontend development. Delivered VR projects as the sole developer and contributed to a mobile RTS, industrial training simulators and AR applications.
skills: Development: Unity, C#, OOP, ScriptableObject, Zenject, UniTask, DOTween, Git.
XR and platforms: Meta Quest 2/3S/3, OpenXR, XR Interaction Toolkit, SteamVR, Vuforia; Android, iOS, PC.
Networking and content: Mirror, Netcode for GameObjects, Photon, PlayFab, Firebase, Azure Functions, Addressables, AssetBundles.

pages.context: Industrial VR training simulators | Unity, C#, Meta Quest
bullets: Build training and assessment scenarios with step-by-step operations, action validation, guidance, error tracking and completion conditions.
Implement interactions with equipment and tools, animations, VFX and audio feedback for Quest 2, 3S and 3.
Extend existing code and mechanics using XR Interaction Toolkit, Zenject, UniTask, Addressables and Unity Localization.

pages.context: Mobile RTS, Android / iOS | Unity, C#, Mirror
bullets: Developed client-server interactions for PvP using Mirror and a system to record and replay battles.
Optimized AI pathfinding for large battles, reducing computational iterations and CPU workload when moving groups of units.
Implemented tournament brackets, result updates and debugging tools; built server-side rewards, game events and push notifications with PlayFab, Firebase and Azure Functions.

pages.context: Frontend until Oct 2024; Unity VR Oct 2024 - Feb 2025; then frontend
bullets: Built MyChessVR as the sole developer: game modes, Stockfish-assisted learning, avatar IK and lipsync, three environments and additive scene loading.
Independently developed a drilling simulator VR demo with equipment interactions and cooperative sessions using Netcode for GameObjects, OpenXR and XR Interaction Toolkit.
During frontend assignments, developed MyChess with React/TypeScript, its Flutter mobile client and web interfaces. Real-time product experience complements multiplayer development.

pages.context: React Jan 2023 - Apr 2023; Unigine VR Apr 2023 - Sep 2023
bullets: Implemented the SARiDU VR training simulator functionality in Unigine: cooperative scenarios, instructor and assessment modes, results logging and session recording.
Developed custom UDP networking and VOIP; worked with SteamVR, HTC VIVE Pro and Astra Linux. Earlier assignments included React website and CMS interfaces.

pages.role: Intern / Junior Unity Developer; later Frontend Developer
pages.context: Unity until Feb 2021; React / Vue Feb 2021 - Feb 2022
bullets: Developed mobile AR applications with Unity/Vuforia; implemented AssetBundle delivery with hash checks, caching and download retries.
Worked on OpenCV and Photon interactives, UI and content integration. Later built React interfaces for Unreal Pixel Streaming and educational portals with Vue, Apollo and GraphQL.

education: Donetsk National University | Computer Science and Engineering. Bachelor's degree, 2020; Master's degree, 2023.
